correctness.rationale: The 4-node de Bruijn graph with output edges recognizes exactly cyclic preimages by a nonzero diagonal Boolean product. A deterministic closure under right multiplication has exactly 75 states, 61 accepting. The included exact arithmetic verifier recomputes all 75 components of T^2*p(T)*v as zero, giving the all-n recurrence; initial counts yield the stated rational GF. Explicit logarithmic derivatives and root separation prove the dominant coefficient 1 and error O(1.381^n). Independent full input enumeration for n=1..16 corroborates, not replaces, the proof.
